scope: attached or recently removed tick without severe allergic symptoms or serious illness
patterns: I found a tick attached to my leg
how do I remove a tick
my child has a tick on the scalp
tick was attached for an unknown amount of time
pulled out a tick but part may be left
small red spot after a tick bite
can I burn a tick off
tick bite and now feel feverish
response: Remove an attached tick promptly with fine-tipped tweezers by grasping it as close to the skin as possible and pulling steadily upward. Clean the bite area and your hands afterward with soap and water. Do not burn, crush, or cover the tick with chemicals. Note the date and location and watch for symptoms in the following weeks.
red_flags: spreading rash, especially a target or bulls-eye pattern
fever, headache, muscle aches, or joint pain in the weeks after a bite
severe swelling or feeling very unwell
tick attached in a difficult location you cannot remove safely
